page: Amazon Web Services r7a.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System. It features 128 dedicated physical cores using the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9R14 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of high-speed 5 GHz DDR5 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This hardware configuration does not include local storage or GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, Passmark CPU tests, and memory bandwidth, with uncached read speeds reaching 565.57 GB/sec. It also demonstrates top-tier efficiency in Redis SET operations, processing 246.48 million operations per second, and in prompt processing for small and medium language models. Single-core performance and static web serving throughput of 84.2 GB/sec fall within the strong top 25% category.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r7a.32xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads, minimizing the overhead of multi-socket configurations through its dedicated single-thread-per-core architecture. The absence of bundled local storage represents a tradeoff, requiring external block storage for persistent data. This instance is highly suited for in-memory databases, large-scale data analytics, software compilation, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
